segments.name: Natural gas liquefaction
segments.description: Builds and develops the Rio Grande LNG Facility, a natural gas liquefaction and export plant near Brownsville, Texas, for LNG sales.
segments.evidence: As such, for purposes of financial reporting under U.S. GAAP, the Company operates as a single operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay under long-term LNG sale and purchase agreements, a fixed fee plus a variable fee per MMBtu of LNG.
revenueModel.evidence: Under these SPAs, the customers will purchase LNG from the Rio Grande LNG Facility for a price consisting of a fixed fee per MMBtu of LNG plus a variable fee per MMBtu of LNG, with the variable fees structured to cover the expected cost of natural gas plus fuel and other sourcing costs to produce LNG.
